description: The paths bots hit most, per (bot category, bot label, path, status code) — the busiest-paths table of Bot Analytics. Rows are `{ botCategory, botLabel, path, statusCode, hitCount, lastSeenAt }`, ordered by hitCount descending, capped at 200. Optionally filter to one bot category (ai_crawler/search_engine/other_bot). An empty result means nothing was measured — no bot path hits were recorded from uploaded logs. FREE (no credits).

botCategory.description: Filter to one bot category; omit for all.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: log_analyzer_top_paths
